static_review.dimension: Q05 actual issuer and current consumer
static_review.conclusion: Signed JWTs and the actual password-login R38 fixture are authenticated through NewRouter. static_review.dimension: Q07 strict transport and protected pagination
static_review.conclusion: Exact 64 KiB valid read and oversized/unknown/duplicate/case-alias/trailing JSON refusals are real raw requests through testutil. Closed cross-route variants, source query and limit validation, two actual retained packages, root/source/viewer/revision cursor binding, empty privacy and old-route/object denial distinction remain protected.

Request-local snapshots include source evaluation/approval/execution/policy/queue state and root status/submission/event/operation/attachment/authorization/terminal/stage facts. Eleven logged hash pairs per run match. Snapshot setup, revocation fixtures and explicit M1 control writes are separately identified.

All eight shape/order barriers reach exactly once on distinct actual PostgreSQL backends; every SQL statement is forwarded. Read-first requires canonical DeleteMember SQLSTATE 55P03 before actual commit and successful deletion afterward; revocation-first commits after Auth and before the read data query. Fresh and cached requests then return exact no-store minimal 404. Reader backend is saved before the later denial. Router drains and no live fixture rows remain.

static_review.dimension: R38 original red and exact narrower replacement
static_review.conclusion: The original 0cbb draft explicitly inserted internal:false, producing SQLSTATE 23514 before HTTP. CHECK(internal) plus unique organization(internal) prevents a second legal organization. The replacement changes only the workspace association to a canonical UUID and proves the real admin/current legal singleton via GET /api/admin/me. Both R38 routes return minimal no-store 404 with zero business effects. This is association fail-closed proof, not second-tenant isolation.

The test reuses existing actual-auth M1 fixtures and testutil insert/request/response helpers. Raw strings are forwarded without re-encoding; QueryRow.Scan fails tests on error. No product/helper/SQL/template/dependency changes or synthetic principal injection were introduced. The first archive is fully validated before adding the second package, then read by its original execution ID.
